sql: SELECT t.transaction_key AS transaction_key, a.award_key AS award_key, a.piid AS piid, a.recipient_name AS recipient_name, t.action_date AS action_date, t.modification_number AS modification_number, t.federal_action_obligation AS obligation_amount FROM transactions AS t JOIN awards AS a ON a.award_key = t.award_key WHERE t.fiscal_year = 2025 AND a.fiscal_year = 2025 ORDER BY t.federal_action_obligation DESC LIMIT 1

WITH fy_actions AS (SELECT t.transaction_key, t.award_key, t.modification_number, t.action_date, t.federal_action_obligation, a.recipient_name FROM transactions AS t JOIN awards AS a ON t.award_key = a.award_key WHERE t.fiscal_year = 2025) SELECT award_key, transaction_key, modification_number, action_date, federal_action_obligation AS obligation, recipient_name FROM fy_actions ORDER BY federal_action_obligation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
